callees.name: new_event_id
callees.post_condition: returns a unique string identifier beginning with the given prefix

callees.name: utc_now_iso
callees.post_condition: returns the current UTC time as an ISO 8601 formatted string

callees.name: _retry_create
callees.pre_condition: client is a callable LLM API client; model is a non-empty string; messages is a list of message dicts with 'role' and 'content' keys
callees.post_condition: returns (response_text: str, usage_dict: dict) representing the LLM response text and token usage; raises an exception on persistent API communication failure after exhausting retries

callees.name: _parse_json_response
callees.pre_condition: response is a string that may contain bare JSON, markdown-fenced code blocks, or prose-wrapped JSON
callees.post_condition: returns the first valid JSON object or array extracted from the response; raises ValueError if no valid JSON can be extracted

callees.name: record_llm_exchange
callees.signature: record_llm_exchange(trace_dir, event_id, event, messages, response) -> None
callees.pre_condition: event_id is a non-empty string; event is a dict with required trace fields; messages is a list of message dicts
callees.post_condition: when trace_dir is truthy, atomically writes the full LLM message exchange and response to trace payload files keyed by event_id; when trace_dir is falsy, is a no-op
